name: a-binding-record-answers-its-doc
query: apply ~(:x |~~ One. ~~| 1 | env | get /x | doc | content)

name: a-group-exposes-the-record-of-a-name-it-declares
query: apply ~((:h 1 | :x (h | add 1) | env | inter #[:x]) | get /x | tag)

name: a-group-exposes-the-value-its-declaration-computed
query: apply ~((:h 1 | :x (h | add 1) | env | inter #[:x]) | get /x | value)

name: doc-reads-the-page-of-a-declaration-that-stands-over-the-name-around
query:
apply ~(:foo |~~| Old doc.
1
| (:foo |~~| New doc.
|~~| With second remark.
2
| ::foo | doc | content))

name: doc-reads-the-page-written-between-a-name-and-its-body
query:
apply ~(42
:snapshot |~~| Captured value.
it
| (::snapshot | doc | content))

name: a-binding-a-reader-writes-holds-the-fields-of-its-kind
query: get [~(::binding{:name :x} !| tag) ~(::binding{:name "x" :docs [] :value 1 :source null :origin null} !| tag) ~(::binding | manifest | has ::binding/docs)]

name: the-record-of-a-name-reads-back-from-its-print
query: apply ~(:x |~~ One. ~~| 5 | ::x | binding | eq (print | parse | open))
